gpt-4o-mini.explanation: In "Show of Evil," William Diehl crafts a gripping thriller that delves into the dark underbelly of crime and justice, as a detective confronts a twisted serial killer. The novel explores themes of obsession and morality, keeping readers on the edge of their seats.

gemma2:9b.explanation: A post-apocalyptic thriller with a gripping narrative.

gemma2:9b.title: Shark
gemma2:9b.explanation: Diehl's suspenseful novel about a man hunted by a great white shark.

gemma2:9b.explanation: A chilling story of a scientist racing against time to stop a deadly epidemic.
